description: Read current displayed resting bid/ask limit orders on Binance, Bybit, OKX or Hyperliquid perpetuals. Use for resting liquidity, order book/DOM and buy/sell walls, NOT orderflow_read, which reads executed trades. Returns timestamp, spread, largest displayed levels and bounded depth coverage. Not historical depth, hidden stops or guaranteed support.

levels.description: Returned largest levels per side. Default 8.

notionalQuote.description: Optional hypothetical order size in quote currency for depth-based VWAP/slippage. Excludes fees and funding.

name: orderbook_read
